story.headline: Dunphy sent down to Lockport, calls it a "betrayal"
story.dek: Ace Dunphy, 3-9 with a 6.12 ERA, will ride the bus.
body: Ace Dunphy was optioned to the Lockport Canallers after his worst start of the year.
"Mr. Haldane promised me a ring," Dunphy said, packing. "He gave me a bus ticket."
Kid Okafor (.388 in AA) takes his roster spot.
